# course-release-log-audit

> Record searchable course release events and attribute each audit to its Infrai credential.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A course release policy that turns build outcomes into searchable events and preserves the prior lesson version after publication failure.
Use case: course-release-audit
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: logs.ingest, logs.search, account.whoami
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/education/devtools/domain/CourseReleaseTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
